title: Programmable generation of flying cat-qubits
summary: We propose a framework for the direct generation of flying cat-qubit states from vacuum using time-dependent two-photon drives in nonlinear bosonic systems. We study both Kerr-based and two-photon-dissipation-based generation. By engineering Kerr nonlinearity, two-photon driving, and dissipation, we demonstrate logical control of a cat qubit during its generation and emission, while its quantum information is simultaneously shared between the nonlinear system and the propagating output field.
